card.name: Partway through drug-interaction wording
card.fires_on: Partway through a long word or number in drug-interaction text, such as the con in concomitant, a drug name's middle, or a digit in a figure. It also fires on linking words like with or before that lead into use or timing.

modes.label: Inside drug and medical words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long drug or class name, or of concomitant.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for carrying out actions or measures, such as operations, interventions and implementations.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug names and on small linking words in drug-interaction and warning text.
